# Components

Every component, by category. Install the **item** with `npx shadcn@latest add https://fancyborders.vercel.app/r/<item>.json` (or `@fancyborders/<item>` with the registry namespace). A **recipe** has no item of its own: install the item it names and copy the code from its docs. Full docs for any component, as Markdown: `https://fancyborders.vercel.app/docs/components/<slug>.md`.

## Frames

Structural frames: brackets, rails, marks and hatching.

| Component | Slug | Item | Exports | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Frame | `frame` | `frame` | `Frame`, `FrameBorder`, `FrameRules`, `FrameCorners`, `FrameFill` | The primitive everything else is built from: an enclosure plus border, rule, corner-mark and fill layers you compose yourself. |
| Bracket Frame | `bracket-frame` | `bracket-frame` | `BracketFrame` | Corner brackets around a dashed border. |
| Hatch Divider | `hatch-divider` | `hatch-divider` | `HatchDivider` | A hatched band between two lines for separating page sections, with marks where it meets the page rails. |
| Crosshair | `crosshair` | `frame` (recipe) | `FrameRules`, `FrameCorners` | Rules that overshoot their corners, with a mark on each one. |
| Blueprint | `blueprint` | `frame` (recipe) | `FrameFill`, `FrameBorder`, `FrameCorners` | A pattern fill behind a border, with marks at the corners. |

## Structure

Rails, rules and section grids that lay out a whole page.

| Component | Slug | Item | Exports | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Page Rails | `page-rails` | `page-rails` | `PageRails` | The column a page is laid out in: a vertical rail down each side, optionally with a patterned gutter. |
| Section Rule | `section-rule` | `section-rule` | `SectionRule` | A line between page sections that runs past the page rails, with a mark on each intersection. |
| Section Grid | `section-grid` | `section-grid` | `SectionGrid` | A grid whose cells share one line between them, with a mark on every crossing and columns that change at breakpoints. |

## Shapes

Outlines that are not rectangles, with borders that follow them.

| Component | Slug | Item | Exports | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Shape Frame | `shape-frame` | `shape-frame` | `ShapeFrame` | A frame whose outline follows a shape: bevelled, notched, scooped or rounded corners, and edges with a bite taken out. |
| Ticket Frame | `ticket-frame` | `ticket-frame` | `TicketFrame` | A ticket with rounded corners, a perforated line and a tear-off stub. |
| Folder Frame | `folder-frame` | `folder-frame` | `FolderFrame` | A folder with a tab on its top edge and a sloping shoulder down to the body. |
| Speech Bubble | `speech-bubble` | `bubble-frame` | `BubbleFrame` | A rounded box with a tail on any edge. The border runs around the tail unbroken. |
| Edge Frame | `edge-frame` | `edge-frame` | `EdgeFrame` | A frame with a pattern cut into its edges: zigzag teeth, waves, scallops or the bites of a stamp. |
| Receipt | `receipt` | `edge-frame` (recipe) | `EdgeFrame` | A slip of paper torn off along a zigzag edge. |
| Stamp | `stamp` | `edge-frame` (recipe) | `EdgeFrame` | A postage stamp: round bites out of all four edges. |

## Lines

Line styles for any frame: dashes, native styles and motion.

| Component | Slug | Item | Exports | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Dash Patterns | `dash-patterns` | `frame` (recipe) | `FrameRules` | Dashed lines with the dash and the gap set independently, which a CSS border cannot do. |
| Border Styles | `border-styles` | `frame` (recipe) | `FrameBorder` | Solid, dashed, dotted and double borders that follow the radius and can sit inside or outside the frame's edge. |
| Marching Ants | `marching-ants` | `frame` (recipe) | `FrameRules` | Dashed rules whose dashes travel around the frame, like a selection rectangle. |

## Effects

Gradient, glow and moving light, as more layers for a frame.

| Component | Slug | Item | Exports | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Beam | `beam` | `beam-frame` | `BeamFrame`, `FrameBeam` | A light that travels the border at a steady speed, around any proportions and any corner. |
| Glow | `glow` | `glow-frame` | `GlowFrame`, `FrameGlow` | A gradient border with a halo of the same colours glowing behind it, still or turning. |
| Gradient | `gradient` | `frame-effects` | `FrameGradient` | A gradient drawn on the frame's line, in any colours and at any angle, optionally turning around the frame. |
| Pulse | `pulse` | `frame-effects` (recipe) | `FrameGlow`, `FrameGradient` | A halo that breathes in and out, for something that is live, recording or waiting. |
| Spotlight | `spotlight` | `frame-spotlight` | `FrameSpotlight` | Borders that light up near the pointer, across every frame on the page at once. |
| Liquid Metal | `liquid-metal` | `frame-metal` | `FrameMetal` | A moving metal ring drawn with WebGL, in chromatic, silver and gold. |

## Registry items

| Item | Built on | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `frame` | – | The frame primitive: an enclosure plus composable border, rule, corner-mark and fill layers. |
| `shape-frame` | `frame` | A frame whose outline follows a shape: bevelled, notched, scooped or rounded corners and punched edges. |
| `frame-effects` | `frame` | Effect layers for a frame in plain CSS: a gradient line, a glow, and a beam of light that travels around the border. |
| `frame-spotlight` | `frame` | A light on the frame's line that follows the pointer, shared across every frame on the page. |
| `frame-metal` | `frame` | Liquid metal on the frame's line, drawn with WebGL, in chromatic, silver and gold. |
| `section-grid` | `frame` | A grid whose cells share one line between them, with a mark on every crossing and columns that change at breakpoints. |
| `bracket-frame` | `frame` | Corner brackets around a dashed border. |
| `hatch-divider` | `frame` | A hatched band between two lines for separating page sections, with marks where it meets the page rails. |
| `page-rails` | `frame` | The column a page is laid out in: a vertical rail down each side, optionally with a patterned gutter. |
| `section-rule` | `frame` | A line between page sections that runs past the page rails, with a mark on each intersection. |
| `ticket-frame` | `shape-frame` | A ticket with rounded corners, a perforated line and a tear-off stub. |
| `folder-frame` | `shape-frame` | A folder with a tab on its top edge and a sloping shoulder. |
| `bubble-frame` | `shape-frame` | A speech bubble: a rounded box with a tail on any edge. |
| `edge-frame` | `shape-frame` | A frame with zigzag, wavy, scalloped or bitten edges, in a whole number of repeats. |
| `beam-frame` | `frame`, `frame-effects` | A quiet border with a light travelling around it. |
| `glow-frame` | `frame`, `frame-effects` | A gradient border with a halo of the same colours behind it. |

Client components (they need the browser): `frame-spotlight`, `frame-metal`, `edge-frame`. Everything else renders on the server.
